title: fix(plugin-security)!: the delegation probes, field projections, explanation and narrowing diagnostic answer the prologue's organization-membership refusal
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu18uVZPm7Af9b2eJRXsZiPa)_

Fixes #25107

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — on a walled posture, the security service's admission probes, field projections, access explanation and narrowing diagnostic answer the operation prologue's refusal for an on-behalf-of context whose live active organization the delegator's membership does not back, where they used to answer an admission.
Metadata-protocol: none

Claim of record: `6348946648` on the card (card thread, `domain:services` seat 1). Branch `claude/project-thread-a7kyo3` is the harness-pinned branch for this session; it names no issue, so the Duplicate Fix Guard's branch-name hint will not match, and the claim is the identity record. ⛔ Disclosure (#9387 ruling `5323310017`): this body states the rule and an abstract reach only.

## The rule

Under `isolated` or `group`, the delegated-principal prologue (`resolveOperationPrincipals`) refuses every operation of an on-behalf-of context whose live active organization the delegator's own membership does not back (ADR-0090 D10, landed with #25063), and the raw-SQL read scope answers that refusal (#25106, PR #25150). Every other reader in `plugin-security` that resolves a delegator on its own skipped the check, so for such a context it answered an admission the operation refuses. The card names them; this PR makes each one ask.

**One ask.** `delegatedOrganizationRefusal` (`explain-engine.ts`, beside `resolveDelegatorContext`) asks `vetOrganizationClaim` once with the prologue's inputs: the live organization (`context.tenantId`), the delegator's own memberships (`accessible_org_ids`, never inherited), the posture. It answers the refused organization or `undefined`. The prologue and `computeDelegatedReadFilter` now ask it instead of spelling the inputs themselves (byte-identical behaviour: their 42 existing cells stay green unchanged), and every other site asks it at the prologue's point, after a resolved delegator and before the delegator's sets resolve:

| site | answer for a refused context (was) |
|:--|:--|
| `canReadObject` | `false` (could be `true`) |
| `canWriteObject` (insert and update) | `false` (could be `true`) |
| `canExport` | `false` (could be `true`) |
| `resolveProjectionFieldMask`, behind `getReadableFields`, `getMetadataReadableFields`, `getWritableFields`, `getQueryableFields` | `[]`, as for a dangling delegator (the intersected list) |
| the explain engine's delegated path (`explainOnce`) | `allowed: false`; the principal and object_crud layers `denies`, naming the organization (the D10 intersection) |
| `describeDelegationNarrowing` | `{ narrowed: false }`, as for a dangling delegator (a narrowing) |
| `delegatedWriteContexts` (the explanation's per-record write gate and authored-row probe) | `null`: the gate refuses without asking the sharing service (asked as agent and delegator) |

`resolveDelegatorContext`'s docblock no longer says the agent and its delegator are "by construction, in the same org": that is the precondition the helper vets, and the docblock points at it.

**`ExplainEngineDeps` gains a required `tenancyPosture`**, which the security plugin wires from its own posture. Required for the reason the module gives for `getPartialMaskRules`: an engine wired without it would explain such a context as admitted, the misreport this card closes, and a required member makes the omission a compile error. The seven test files that build the deps by hand pass `'single'`. The changeset names this with `runtime-interface-only` (the interface has no metadata surface; the compiler is the channel that reaches an embedder).

## Reach, abstractly

In process only, as the card says: the one producer of an on-behalf-of context (the `/mcp` door) never builds the shape, and none of these readers serves rows (their consumers run the operation through the engine, which refuses).

## Boundary, before and after

- **Before:** under `isolated` or `group`, for such a context the three probes could answer `true`, the projections the intersected fields, the explanation `allowed: true`, the diagnostic a narrowing, and the per-record write gate asked the sharing service.
- **After:** each answers the refusal, as tabled above.
- **Unchanged:** the `single` posture; an on-behalf-of context with no active organization; an on-behalf-of context in an organization the delegator belongs to; a context without `onBehalfOf`; a dangling delegator; system contexts.

## Docs

- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`, row 6b: the list of arms `canWriteObject` runs gains, in its fail-closed group, the walled-posture D10 delegator who is not a member of the organization the request runs in (commit `981b7c2f`, one line, flagged by the docs drift check).

## Pins

All in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-organization-membership.test.ts`, the rule's file (real `ObjectQL` from source, real `SqlDriver`, real `SecurityPlugin`; the delegator rebuilt from stored rows). 24 new cases; the file goes from 42 to 66. The fixture gains `allowExport` on its three grants (so the export probe's admitted cells are admitted by a grant) and one object only the narrowing cells read, with a delegator grant and an agent ceiling for it.

- **Refusal (10):** per walled posture × the three objects (public, private, organization-less): `canReadObject`, `canWriteObject` insert and update and `canExport` are `false`, the four projections `[]`, the explanation `allowed: false` with both layers denying and naming the organization; per walled posture, the narrowing diagnostic answers `{ narrowed: false }`, and the explanation's per-record write gate never calls the sharing service's `canEdit`.
- **Preservation (11):** per walled posture, a delegated context in a member organization and the undelegated caller are admitted by every probe on every object; a delegated context with no active organization keeps its read answers; the diagnostic still reports a narrowing in a member organization; the write gate still asks `canEdit` as the agent, then as the delegator; and the `single` posture admits every probe and reports the narrowing.
- **Parity (2):** per walled posture, over three contexts × three objects: `canReadObject`, `canExport` and the explanation's `allowed` equal whether the engine's find runs, and `canWriteObject` insert equals whether the engine's insert runs. The table asserts its refused set, so neither side is vacuous.
- **Enumeration (1):** per source file in this package, the calls of `delegatedOrganizationRefusal` equal the calls of `resolveDelegatorContext` (definitions excluded), and the two files that resolve a delegator are both counted: a tenth reader that resolves one without asking goes red.

One existing pin moves, because this change makes its fixture the refused shape: `explain-dependency-fault.test.ts`'s control "a delegator that resolves leaves the principal layer neutral" runs on a walled stack (org scoping, so `isolated`) whose delegator had no membership in the organization its agent runs in, so with the fix its principal layer read `denies` (the package suite caught it). Its fixture seeds that membership, so the cell measures what it names; its sibling (the delegator's grants unreadable, explain fails closed) is untouched.

One-time proofs (not left as tests), each in `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` WRAP mode (anchor must hit once, blob must move, restore proven: blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty). The subject is imported from source (`./security-plugin.js`), so there is no `dist/` leg.

| leg | what is undone (tree only) | file reading | red cells |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 0, red first | both source files at the base (`cc8d886d`), the new tests kept | 13 failed, 53 passed | the 6 refusal cells, the 2 narrowing-refusal cells, the 2 write-gate cells, the 2 parity cells, the enumeration cell; the 42 existing cells green |
| 1 | `describeDelegationNarrowing`'s ask | 3 failed | narrowing refusal × 2, enumeration |
| 2 | `delegatedWriteContexts`' ask | 3 failed | write gate × 2, enumeration |
| 3 | `resolveProjectionFieldMask`'s ask | 7 failed | refusal × 6, enumeration |
| 4 | `canReadObject`'s ask | 9 failed | refusal × 6, parity × 2, enumeration |
| 5 | `canWriteObject`'s ask | 9 failed | refusal × 6, parity × 2, enumeration |
| 6 | `canExport`'s ask | 9 failed | refusal × 6, parity × 2, enumeration |
| 7 | `explainOnce`'s ask | 11 failed | refusal × 6, write gate × 2, parity × 2, enumeration |
| 8 | the helper itself answers `undefined` (call counts kept) | 36 failed, 30 passed | every refusal cell of the file, the prologue's and the read scope's 24 included; the enumeration cell stays green, as it should (it counts asks) |

Every leg restored: blob equal to HEAD (`security-plugin.ts` `4e9f0dc892a5`, `explain-engine.ts` `aee792270aa0`) and `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Tests and gates

Read on head `8bb2d5e0`, branched from `cc8d886d`. Every test run went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`; each exit code was captured before any pipe.

- **Dependency closure:** `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...' --concurrency=3`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The eight packages outside it that `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` reads were built too (exit 0).
- **The package:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 209 passed (209)`, `Tests 4320 passed | 45 skipped (4365)`. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security run typecheck`: exit 0.
- **The suites outside the package that build an on-behalf-of context through the real `SecurityPlugin`:** `objectql` `engine-readable-ids-nested-composition` (12/12), `service-storage` `attachment-read-leaf.integration` + `attachment-access-hooks` (152/152), `plugin-sharing` `authored-row-write-deferral` (20/20), `plugin-audit` `comment-access-hooks` + `parent-record-read-leaf.integration` (83/83), `runtime` `http-dispatcher` (248/248): each exit 0.
- **The derived gate families:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 70 commands; all 70 exit 0 (`check:type-check-debt` re-run under the lock after its first call timed out queueing behind the battery, which is a prerequisite reading, not a verdict). `--ran`: `70 derived, 70 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`, exit 0. The three roster gates whose roster sits under a directory this diff touches (`check-changeset-fixed`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`) were run as well: exit 0.
- **Full dogfood battery** (the title carries `!`): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, no shard, no path: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, `Test Files 289 passed | 3 skipped (292)`, `Tests 2481 passed | 18 skipped (2499)`.
- **Not run locally, declared to CI:** the type-check lanes and the path-scheduled CI jobs `dispatch-gates` names.

**Serial.** #25256 (#25095) landed on `main` after this branch was cut and edits `security-plugin.ts` in hunks disjoint from these (a test merge is clean); CI's run on this PR reads the merge with it.

## Acceptance notes

- The helper lives in `explain-engine.ts` beside `resolveDelegatorContext` because the explain engine (a module function, no plugin instance) asks it too; it adds no rule text: `vetOrganizationClaim` stays the one spelling of "a membership backs this organization".
- The probes answer silently (no log), as each already answers a dangling delegator silently; the prologue and the read scope keep their `warn`.
- A review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is owed before the queue (a narrowing).
